packageRules.description: The chart's own image follows the chart's appVersion; never pin it.
helm's SHA-256 is changed by hand (customManagers), so its update stays out of the group, and fails CI alone until then.
bun's SHA-256 is changed by hand (customManagers), so its update stays out of the group, and fails the pages build alone until then.

customManagers.description: cosign of .github/actions/setup-cosign: its version, and the SHA-256 of cosign-linux-amd64, which the release's cosign_checksums.txt holds (RFC0007, requirement 29).

helm of .github/actions/setup-helm: its version only. Helm publishes its archives and their SHA-256 on get.helm.sh, not as assets of its GitHub releases, so the SHA-256 is changed by hand, and the job fails on it until then (RFC0007, requirement 29).

bun of .github/actions/setup-bun, which builds the documentation site: its version only. The SHA-256 of bun-linux-x64.zip, from its release's SHASUMS256.txt, is changed by hand, and the pages build fails on it until then.
The release's BuildKit image, by tag and digest (RFC0007, requirement 29).
